newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish NTMA to announce auction details on May 15.
newsitem.headline: Irish NTMA to announce auction details on May 15.

text.p: Ireland's National Treasury Management Agency (NTMA) will, under new procedures, announce details of an auction three days before it is is held.
Details giving the amount and maturity date of stock to be auctioned on Tuesday 20 will be announced on Thursday May 15.
As part of a series of recent changes the NTMA will not, in the normal course, issue a tap in the bond maturity range being auctioned during the three business days before or after the auction.
Switching facilities in the bond maturity range being auctioned will not be provided during the week in which the auction is held, the NTMA said.
